scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@liderplast/landing-static && npm run build --workspace=@liderplast/app-react
scripts.deploy:prepare-dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -R packages/landing-static/dist/* dist/ && mkdir dist/tienda && cp -R packages/app-react/dist/* dist/tienda/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:prepare-dist
scripts.deploy:landing: npm run build:landing && rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -R packages/landing-static/dist/* dist/
